tasks.label: docker:quick-up
tasks.command: if (-not (docker network ls --format "{{.Name}}" | Select-String -Pattern "^br_dashboard$" -Quiet)) { docker network create --driver=bridge --subnet=192.168.128.0/24 --gateway=192.168.128.1 br_dashboard | Out-Null }; docker compose -f docker-compose-db.yaml up -d; docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml up -d; docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml ps

tasks.label: docker:bootstrap-full
tasks.command: if (-not (docker network ls --format "{{.Name}}" | Select-String -Pattern "^br_dashboard$" -Quiet)) { docker network create --driver=bridge --subnet=192.168.128.0/24 --gateway=192.168.128.1 br_dashboard | Out-Null }; docker compose -f docker-compose-db.yaml up -d; docker compose -f docker-compose-init.yaml up -d; docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml up -d; docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml ps

tasks.label: docker:down
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml down; docker compose -f docker-compose-db.yaml down
